name: Church And State
overview: Scripture teaches a clear distinction between the roles of church and state, emphasizing that believers are to render to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 22:21 and Mark 12:17. The example of Cyrus and Darius, kings who actively supported the restoration and protection of God's temple (Ezra 1:1, Ezra 6:1), shows that civil authorities can be favorable to religion without usurping ecclesiastical functions. Furthermore, John 8:47 highlights the spiritual authority of God’s word, which transcends civil power, underscoring the supremacy of divine truth over human governance.
